title: Energy System Guide ⚡
description:
Here is how the Energy system works in Game Tuner:
• Max Limit: 120 ⚡
• Watch Ad: +20 ⚡
• Apply Features: -15 ⚡
• Import / Download Plugin: -40 ⚡
Maintain your energy balance to keep using premium features.
